description: KUP Solutions sends transactional appointment and staff-security SMS for people who opt in on KUP-hosted booking sites. Shop name is appointment detail, not a second messaging brand. Not marketing.
message_flow: End users opt in on KUP-hosted booking forms. The live control is at https://www.emmiwood.com/emmiwood/book (a JavaScript booking form; reviewers will not see the checkbox in the raw HTML). They may optionally check a box agreeing to receive confirmation and reminder messages from KUP Solutions about that appointment. Consent is not required to complete a booking. The checkbox is unchecked by default. The opt-in checkbox and disclosures are documented at https://www.emmiwood.com/emmiwood/opt-in-evidence/ (static evidence page presenting one messaging brand: KUP Solutions). Privacy Policy: https://kup.solutions/sms/privacy (states that mobile phone numbers and messaging consent are not shared, sold, or provided to third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes). SMS Terms: https://kup.solutions/sms/terms (program name, frequency, rates, STOP, and HELP). Campaign website: https://kup.solutions/sms . Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Customers reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. Staff admin one-time passcodes are sent only to allowlisted administrator mobile numbers for portal security, not marketing. A hosted shop or business name may appear in a message as appointment details and is not a second messaging brand.
